notes.title: The Man Came Around : Steam Next Fest Livestream #2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm pleased to announce that The Man Came Around will be part of the Steam Next Fest with a brand new demo!

I will also do a livestream where I will show some bits of the game, talk about its development, and answer any questions you have.

The Stream will start on Saturday, June 18 2022
at :

- 3 PM CDT (East Coast)
- 1 PM PDT (West Coast)
- 10 PM CET (Central European Time, GMT +1)


See you soon!

notes.title: The Man Came Around : Livestream at The Big Adventure Event!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm pleased to announce that [b]The Man Came Around[/b] has been selected as one of the games showcased during [b]The Big Adventure Event[/b]!

I will show some bits of the game, talk about its development, and answer any questions you have (as long as they're respectful, of course).

The Stream will start on [b]Saturday, January 22 2022[/b] at :

[i]- 12 PM CDT (East Coast, GMT +6)
- 10 AM PDT (West Coast, GMT + 8)
- 7 PM CET (Central European Time, GMT +1)[/i]

See you soon!
